_comment: The machine these numbers were measured on. A baseline is a measurement of one machine: comparing a run on different hardware does not measure a regression, it measures the hardware. scripts/bench-compare.py reads this file, compares cpu_model against the machine it is running on, and refuses to call a regression when they differ. Refresh it with the same commit as the baseline it describes.
note: simd is ON here, so the resize/* rows are the fast_image_resize kernel, not image's. The reference-kernel comparison is core/examples/resize_bench.rs.
